cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(JAVM_POSIX_CURL LANGUAGES C)
set(BUILD_CURL_EXE ON)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
set(BUILD_STATIC_LIBS ON)
set(BUILD_TESTING OFF)
set(BUILD_LIBCURL_DOCS OFF)
set(BUILD_MISC_DOCS OFF)
set(ENABLE_CURL_MANUAL OFF)
set(CURL_USE_OPENSSL ON)
set(OPENSSL_USE_STATIC_LIBS TRUE)
# 查找根目录只是提示，必须将头文件与静态库固定到同一份已构建的 SDK。
# Intel macOS 的 /usr/local/include 可能带有另一版本的 OpenSSL。
if(NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR}/include/openssl")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing component OpenSSL SDK")
endif()
set(OPENSSL_INCLUDE_DIR "${OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR}/include" CACHE PATH "Component OpenSSL headers" FORCE)
set(OPENSSL_SSL_LIBRARY "${OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR}/lib/libssl.a" CACHE FILEPATH "Component OpenSSL SSL library" FORCE)
set(OPENSSL_CRYPTO_LIBRARY "${OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR}/lib/libcrypto.a" CACHE FILEPATH "Component OpenSSL crypto library" FORCE)
find_package(OpenSSL REQUIRED)
set_target_properties(OpenSSL::SSL OpenSSL::Crypto PROPERTIES SYSTEM FALSE)
include_directories(BEFORE "${OPENSSL_INCLUDE_DIR}")
set(CURL_CA_FALLBACK ON)
set(CURL_USE_LIBPSL OFF)
set(CURL_USE_LIBSSH2 OFF)
set(USE_LIBIDN2 OFF)
set(CURL_USE_GSSAPI OFF)
set(CURL_USE_LIBUV OFF)
set(ENABLE_ARES OFF)
set(CURL_ZLIB OFF CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(CURL_BROTLI OFF CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(CURL_ZSTD OFF CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(USE_NGHTTP2 OFF)
set(CURL_USE_PKGCONFIG OFF)
set(CURL_DISABLE_WEBSOCKETS OFF)
foreach(protocol DICT FILE FTP GOPHER IMAP IPFS LDAP LDAPS MQTT POP3 RTSP SMTP TELNET TFTP)
    set(CURL_DISABLE_${protocol} ON)
endforeach()
if(APPLE)
    set(USE_APPLE_SECTRUST ON)
else()
    set(CURL_CA_BUNDLE "/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt" CACHE STRING "Ubuntu CA bundle" FORCE)
    set(CURL_CA_PATH "/etc/ssl/certs" CACHE STRING "Ubuntu CA directory" FORCE)
endif()
add_subdirectory("${JAVM_CURL_SOURCE}" upstream)
